<think>**Choosing parallel carry logic**

**Building 4-bit carry groups**

**Implementing grouped carry helper**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu_carry4 #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64,
    parameter SUB = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] y
);
    localparam GROUPS = (WIDTH+3)/4;
    localparam PAD = GROUPS*4;
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(GROUPS);
    wire [PAD-1:0] p, g;
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] gp [0:LEVELS];
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] gg [0:LEVELS];
    wire [GROUPS:0] carry;
    genvar i, k, l;
    generate
        for (i=0; i<PAD; i=i+1) begin: bits_pg
            if (i<WIDTH) begin: real_bit
                wire bx;
                assign bx = b[i] ^ (SUB != 0);
                assign p[i] = a[i] ^ bx;
                assign g[i] = a[i] & bx;
            end else begin: padding
                assign p[i] = 1'b1;
                assign g[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        for (k=0; k<GROUPS; k=k+1) begin: groups
            assign gp[0][k] = p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & p[4*k];
            assign gg[0][k] = g[4*k+3]
                | (p[4*k+3] & g[4*k+2])
                | (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & g[4*k+1])
                | (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & g[4*k]);
        end
        for (l=0; l<LEVELS; l=l+1) begin: prefix_level
            for (k=0; k<GROUPS; k=k+1) begin: prefix_group
                if (k >= (1 << l)) begin: combine
                    assign gp[l+1][k] = gp[l][k] & gp[l][k-(1 << l)];
                    assign gg[l+1][k] = gg[l][k] | (gp[l][k] & gg[l][k-(1 << l)]);
                end else begin: pass
                    assign gp[l+1][k] = gp[l][k];
                    assign gg[l+1][k] = gg[l][k];
                end
            end
        end
    endgenerate
    assign carry[0] = (SUB != 0);
    generate
        for (k=0; k<GROUPS; k=k+1) begin: local_sum
            wire [3:0] c;
            assign carry[k+1] = gg[LEVELS][k] | (gp[LEVELS][k] & (SUB != 0));
            assign c[0] = carry[k];
            assign c[1] = g[4*k] | (p[4*k] & carry[k]);
            assign c[2] = g[4*k+1] | (p[4*k+1] & g[4*k])
                | (p[4*k+1] & p[4*k] & carry[k]);
            assign c[3] = g[4*k+2] | (p[4*k+2] & g[4*k+1])
                | (p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & g[4*k])
                | (p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & p[4*k] & carry[k]);
            for (i=0; i<4; i=i+1) begin: sum_bit
                if ((4*k+i)<WIDTH) begin: real_bit
                    assign y[4*k+i] = p[4*k+i] ^ c[i];
                end
            end
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_result, ab_result, ba_result;
    wire [6:0] select_op;
    pw_alu_carry4 #(.WIDTH(WIDTH), .SUB(0)) add_unit (.a(a), .b(b), .y(add_result));
    pw_alu_carry4 #(.WIDTH(WIDTH), .SUB(1)) ab_unit (.a(a), .b(b), .y(ab_result));
    pw_alu_carry4 #(.WIDTH(WIDTH), .SUB(1)) ba_unit (.a(b), .b(a), .y(ba_result));
    assign select_op[0] = (Oper == 3'b000);
    assign select_op[1] = (Oper == 3'b001);
    assign select_op[2] = (Oper == 3'b010);
    assign select_op[3] = (Oper == 3'b011);
    assign select_op[4] = (Oper == 3'b100);
    assign select_op[5] = (Oper == 3'b101);
    assign select_op[6] = (Oper == 3'b110);
    always @* begin
        sum = ({WIDTH{select_op[0]}} & add_result)
            | ({WIDTH{select_op[1]}} & ab_result)
            | ({WIDTH{select_op[2]}} & ba_result)
            | ({WIDTH{select_op[3]}} & (a | b))
            | ({WIDTH{select_op[4]}} & (a & b))
            | ({WIDTH{select_op[5]}} & (a ^ b))
            | ({WIDTH{select_op[6]}} & (a ~^ b));
    end
endmodule

module pw_pipeline_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32,
    parameter STAGES = 2
)(
    input wire clk, rst,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    input wire in_valid,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] result,
    output wire out_valid
);
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] operand_a, operand_b;
    reg [2:0] opcode;
    reg input_valid;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] alu_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] stage_data [0:STAGES-2];
    wire stage_valid [0:STAGES-2];

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            operand_a <= 0;
            operand_b <= 0;
            opcode <= 0;
            input_valid <= 0;
        end else begin
            operand_a <= a;
            operand_b <= b;
            opcode <= Oper;
            input_valid <= in_valid;
        end
    end

    pw_alu #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) alu (
        .a(operand_a), .b(operand_b), .Oper(opcode), .sum(alu_result)
    );

    genvar index;
    generate
        for (index=0; index<STAGES-1; index=index+1) begin: output_pipeline
            reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_reg;
            reg valid_reg;
            wire [WIDTH-1:0] next_data;
            wire next_valid;
            if (index == 0) begin: first_stage
                assign next_data = alu_result;
                assign next_valid = input_valid;
            end else begin: following_stage
                assign next_data = stage_data[index-1];
                assign next_valid = stage_valid[index-1];
            end
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                if (rst) begin
                    data_reg <= 0;
                    valid_reg <= 0;
                end else begin
                    data_reg <= next_data;
                    valid_reg <= next_valid;
                end
            end
            assign stage_data[index] = data_reg;
            assign stage_valid[index] = valid_reg;
        end
    endgenerate
    assign result = stage_data[STAGES-2];
    assign out_valid = stage_valid[STAGES-2];
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The operand-register-to-result-register path includes arithmetic carry propagation followed by operation selection and synchronous-reset selection. At WIDTH=16, carry propagation is the principal combinational optimization target.",
  "rewrite": "Replace inferred arithmetic with three parallel, fixed-function carry-lookahead datapaths. Four-bit groups calculate propagate and generate; a logarithmic group-prefix network supplies group carries, and explicit local lookahead supplies individual sum carries. Decode the opcode in parallel and combine operation results using masked OR selection. Leave every pipeline register, register name, reset value and sequential update unchanged.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The explicit sparse-prefix structure limits long carry dependencies and is intended to improve setup WNS relative to a ripple-oriented mapping. Actual improvement depends on SKY130HD mapping, placement and buffering; no measured timing gain is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Lookahead introduces additional propagate/generate logic and routing, while parallel arithmetic avoids opcode-controlled logic inside carry paths. No registers or pipeline stages are added. The 4573.511360um2 area cap, mapped equivalence, STA and electrical limits require tool verification; they have not been measured here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves modulo-2^WIDTH addition and both subtraction directions, all four bitwise operations, and zero for opcode 111. WIDTH remains parameterized, including partial final carry groups. STAGES and the original pipeline structure are unchanged. Valid does not gate data updates. Synchronous reset and repeated resets retain their original priority and values. No initialization, extra state, startup assumptions or input restrictions are introduced; arbitrary initial register values are handled by retaining the original state and transitions."
}
